description: This file defines the MainTvFragment class, which is a TV interface fragment displaying rows of ongoing sports matches grouped by league. It fetches match data via MatchRepository, organizes it into rows with headers, and handles user interactions such as clicking on a match to view details. It also includes a presenter class for rendering match cards with images.

classes.name: MainTvFragment
classes.description: A fragment for displaying a TV interface with live match updates grouped by league, handling user clicks to show match details.

classes.name: MatchCardPresenter
classes.description: A presenter for rendering match information cards optimized for TV navigation, including image loading.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets titles, colors, adapter, image loader, and begins observing match data.

methods.name: observeMatches
methods.description: Launches a coroutine to collect match updates and rebuilds the display rows.

methods.name: buildRows
methods.description: Organizes matches by league into rows with headers and updates the adapter.
